However, the usage of PerInstanceMemory is also allowed in this case. ⌋(RS_- SWCT_03040) [TPS_SWCT_01362] Initialization of PerInstanceMemory⌈Note that the PerIn- stanceMemory is not initialized by the RTE if no initValue is defined.
